item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-09-24 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 8 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (4). Linux has the most new KEV entries this week (3). CVE-2026-85046 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 545 positions.
